alphabet.title: Gujarati Script Foundations
alphabet.explain: Devanagari's sister with NO headline bar — the letters hang free. If you read Hindi, you'll decode Gujarati fast; a few letters (ખ ગ જ ટ ણ ફ) look different enough to learn fresh.

counting.title: Gujarati Numbers
counting.explain: Gujarati counts directly — number + noun, no classifier words:
rules: Learn one to twenty as complete forms.
A numeral normally comes before the noun it counts.
